item.title: Genius Electronic Optical revenue rose 39% in July as lens demand entered peak season
item.summary: Genius Electronic Optical (GSEO) reported July 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$2.422 billion on August 7, up 39.28% from NT$1.739 billion in June and 1.63% from NT$2.384 billion a year earlier. Cumulative consolidated revenue for the first seven months of 2026 reached NT$14.245 billion, an increase of 14.2% from NT$12.474 billion in the same period of 2025.
